# livekit_project_members (Data Source)

The members of a project and their roles, ordered by user ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "livekit_project_members" "this" {}

output "admins" {
  value = [for m in data.livekit_project_members.this.members : m.email if m.role == "admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`). Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `role` (String) `read`, `write`, `admin`, or `invited` for a pending invitee.
- `user_id` (String) The user's ID.
